data.credibility: Management generally delivers on stated operational and guidance goals like UNLOXCYT and top-line targets, though they occasionally drop specific research timelines such as the GL0034 phase-2b study without formal updates.

lines.line: Promised UNLOXCYT U.S. launch in second half of FY 26 and delivered as stated.
Promised ILUMYA sBLA filing in second half of FY 26 and delivered on target.
Promised GL0034 study in 12 to 18 months, but dropped mention across four quarters.
Guided high single-digit top-line growth for FY27; actual reached 11.2% over two quarters.
Guided FY27 R&D spend at 6% to 7% of sales; remains on track.
Guided Organon acquisition completion in Q4 FY27; currently on track.
Guided tax rate to match Q1 until Organon closing; status remains pending review.

bull: Revenue compounded at 11.8% annually over five years, while net profit grew at 38.3% per year.
EBITDA margin expanded from 25.3% in FY21 to 28.2% in FY26, reaching 29.3% TTM.
Extremely strong balance sheet with debt-to-equity of 0.04 and operating cash flow at 120% of net profit.
bear: Valuation stands elevated at a P/E ratio of 36.7 based on TTM figures.
Management dropped tracking on the GL0034 phase-2b study timeline after initial guidance.
Geographic and segment concentration relies heavily on India Formulations at 33% and Innovative Medicines at 22%.
